claims.text: The rider does not contest the arrival or dwell limbs on this record. The derived arrival block places the driver inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius for one continuous run of 454 seconds (46 qualifying fixes, first fix 21:58:18, last fix 22:05:52), against the 300 second free waiting period carried in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec, and that run begins at the arrival event itself (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), so the rider cannot say the in-radius fixes are low-accuracy ones and cannot say the arrival marker was false or that the waiting period fell short. The rider's case therefore rests on POL-NS-01 limb (d), not on arrival, dwell or the marker.

The rider's case is POL-NS-01 limb (d). The driver's own contemporaneous record shows he had not located the rider: the only message on the trip was sent by the driver 30 seconds after he tapped 'I'm Here' and asks 'which door are you at'. Limb (d) is satisfied only by a termination in which the rider failed to appear, and POL-NS-01 expressly refuses that limb to a driver who could not find the rider (DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE) - the reason code on the record is the driver's own selection, not a fact about what happened. Where the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, the clause directs that the fee is not chargeable, that the cancellation fee is refunded in full with no driver compensation, and that the mis-selected reason code is recorded in the ruling's referrals as a driver-education item; the derived arrival block puts every one of the driver's qualifying fixes inside the 50 m radius.

No advisory covers this pickup road in this window. EV-ADVIS-02704-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and the rider relies on that absence and not on any content of the artifact. No KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT advisory was in force, so the waiting clock cannot be extended, topped up or assembled out of separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i): the required minimum has to be met by one continuous interval measured on the GPS clock, and nothing may be added to it.

The rider does not claim exoneration under POL-NS-04 and asks the Judge to note why: limb (a) requires at least one message SENT BY THE RIDER in the waiting window, and the chat log carries one message only, sent by the driver at 21:58:48 and read at 21:59:38, so the clause cannot be run for the rider and the rider does not ask the Judge to read the read receipt as a rider message. What the rider does ask the Judge to record is the counterpart of that clause: the driver sent nothing further and placed no in-app voice call - trip_record.in_app_calls is empty - in the 6 minutes 17 seconds between the read receipt and the cancellation, which is consistent with the rider's submission that the driver had not located him at the pickup point.

If the Judge finds limb (d) of POL-NS-01 unsatisfied, the amount in issue is the cancellation-fee line and nothing else: fare_breakdown shows cancellation_fee 4.00, total_charged 4.00, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. On the in-radius DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE outcome the clause refunds that line in full and pays no driver compensation, so the rider seeks reversal of the SGD 4.00 fee only; under POL-GEN-03 the ruling value names the filing party's outcome, and no booking fee, platform fee or fare item is in issue.

claims.text: The trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event for this trip at 21:58:18, which satisfies POL-NS-01 limb (a): the record shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at the registered pickup point and the platform started the free waiting timer two seconds later at 21:58:20.

POL-NS-01 limb (b) and the POL-NS-02 proximity test are satisfied on the driver's own trace: the first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 21:58:18 — the same second as the arrival event — and the driver's minimum recorded distance from the pickup pin is 0.11 m, far inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius (76+ of the 81 fixes being in-geofence-equivalent, with 46 counted as qualifying in the derived arrival block).

POL-NS-01 limb (c) is satisfied and then some: the driver held position continuously inside the geofence for 454 seconds, from 21:58:18 to 22:05:52, against the 300 second free waiting period in force for this trip under trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec — a surplus of 154 seconds, not a shortfall (the derived shortfall figure is -154.0 s).

POL-NS-01 limb (d) is satisfied: the trip was terminated by the driver at 22:05:55 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes the limb recognises — the record shows no boarding event and no started_at, and the cancellation fell 153 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 22:03:22.

The arrival marker is not false and no waiting-clock recomputation is needed under POL-NS-05: at the arrival timestamp 21:58:18 the driver's trace places him 0.11 m from the pickup pin and stationary (a derived dwell-start offset of 0.0 s), so he was neither more than 300 m away nor travelling at 15 km/h or above; the clock runs from the tap, and the dwell measured from it clears the minimum.

POL-NS-06 (waiting-period shortfall) does not bite: the effective dwell of 454 s exceeds the required minimum, so no full refund arises; and the only route that could matter — summing separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i) — is both unnecessary (the trace shows a single continuous run, run_count 1) and unavailable, because EV-ADVIS-02704-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0) and POL-NS-06(i) requires a traffic_advisory that is present and populated. I disclose that the advisory artifact carries weight 0.0 and assert no fact from it.

POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider. Limb (a) fails because no rider message exists in the waiting window: the chat log holds a single message, sent by the driver at 21:58:48 ('I am at the bay, which door are you at'), delivered at 21:58:49 and read at 21:59:38, and the rider never replied. Limb (c) is affirmatively failed rather than undecidable — the rider track is present and the derived arrival block records rider_qualifying_fix_count of 0 against the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius.

The rider's account — that the driver cancelled 'while I was walking to the bay' — is contradicted by the rider's own device: all 72 rider fixes report a single speed of 0.0 km/h and sit between 606.0 m and 613.4 m from the pickup pin across the window, so the rider was stationary and more than 600 m away, not approaching the bay.

POL-NS-03 does not apply and no pin-ambiguity goodwill is payable: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius rather than outside it, so the wrong-entrance limb is not engaged; and the trip record shows registered_pickup_points of 1 and venue_id VEN-TB-CRES, so the POL-NS-03(ii) condition of 2 or more registered pickup points cannot be met.

POL-NS-10 gives the rider nothing: the trip was terminated by the driver, not cancelled by the rider, and it was not a scheduled trip; the fare ledger carries a waiting-time line of SGD 0.00, so limbs (d) and (e) have nothing to refund and the grace limbs (a) and (b) do not arise.

With all four POL-NS-01 limbs satisfied and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing them, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee — SGD 3.20, exactly the driver_compensation figure the fare ledger already computes — and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and 2 divided by completed_trips_30d of 111 is 0.018, below 0.08. Those are the only two profile fields POL-NS-07 permits me to use here.

No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present: every artifact in the bundle is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 except the MISSING advisory, which carries no fact for either side, no two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0 and the counterparty-dispute counters are 0 on both profiles, and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip — so nothing caps confidence below 0.70 and a monetary ruling must issue rather than a hold.

The charge is sound and the present state should be left standing: the fare ledger's cancellation-fee line of SGD 4.00 reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.00, the net figure under fee_schedule.resolution_rule, so no POL-NS-08(d) integrity defect exists; payment_status is CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd of 0.00, and on this rider-filed dispute a NO_ACTION disposition under POL-GEN-03 preserves that charge — while the fee disposition and the driver's SGD 3.20 payout under POL-NS-07 together produce a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling.

ruling.explanation: Rider and driver: the SGD 4.00 no-show fee stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.20 of it (80 percent), the platform retaining the residual SGD 0.80. I ran the four POL-NS-01 conditions on the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log and the fare ledger. Arrival: the trip record carries a driver 'arrived' event at 21:58:18, and the GPS trace's first in-geofence fix falls at the same second, 0.11 m from the pickup pin and well inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, with 46 consecutive qualifying fixes - limbs (a) and (b) hold. Dwell: one continuous in-geofence run of 454 seconds, 21:58:18 to 22:05:52, against the 300 second free waiting period in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec - a surplus, not a shortfall. Limb (d): the trip was terminated by the driver at 22:05:55 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the dwell elapsed, with no boarding event. The rider's arguments do not change this. His submission that the driver had not located him, drawn from the driver's 21:58:48 message ('I am at the bay, which door are you at'), is rejected: limb (d)'s own test is the recorded cancellation reason code, and the code recorded is RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three limb (d) recognises; DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE is not on the record, and the record contradicts it. The rider's own device places him stationary (0.0 km/h in all 72 fixes) between 606 m and 613 m from the pin across the whole window - he was not walking to the bay, and he neither sent a message nor replied to the driver's. POL-NS-04 therefore cannot exonerate him (limb (a) fails for want of any rider message; limb (c) fails on his own track), and POL-NS-11 does not arise because the rider track is present. POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance does not apply: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and the trip carries 1 registered pickup point, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. POL-NS-05 does not apply: at the arrival timestamp the driver was 0.11 m from the pin and stationary, so the BUTTON marker is not false and no waiting-clock recomputation is needed. POL-NS-06 gives nothing: the 454 s dwell exceeds the 300 s minimum, so the MISSING traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02704-01, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT - disclosed, and relied on only for its absence) cannot matter, and no interval-summing is required. The rider's POL-NS-10 submissions are correct and afford him nothing (the trip was terminated by the driver, was not scheduled, and the fare ledger's waiting-time line is SGD 0.00). Compensation is fixed by POL-NS-07 at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee, SGD 3.20, matching the driver_compensation figure the fare ledger computes, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below 4, and 2 of 111 completed trips is 0.018, below 0.08. Confidence is 0.9, above the 0.70 floor. The cap is 1.0: the deciding facts are carried by artifacts at weight_multiplier 1.0 (trip record, GPS trace, fare ledger, driver profile), and nothing carrying a deciding fact is impaired under POL-NS-08 - no clock skew, a 0.0 s maximum trace gap at 100 percent coverage, the chat log matches trip_record.chat_message_count, and the SGD 4.00 cancellation-fee line reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires, so the case does not escalate. No clause produces a referral: there is no false-arrival record under POL-NS-05(ii), no mis-selected-code driver-education item under POL-NS-01 because limb (d) is satisfied on the code actually recorded, and no POL-NS-07 escalation packet because the anti-farming check does not trip. Per POL-GEN-03, on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd, so SGD 3.20 in both fields; the rider's own charge is untouched. Under POL-GEN-05 the monetary effect, SGD 3.20, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold and executes automatically. This is an automated, provisional ruling; either party may appeal once under POL-GEN-04.

To both parties — this is a provisional automated ruling; either of you may appeal it once under POL-GEN-04.

OUTCOME. The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02704 stands (no refund to the rider), and driver DRV-09704 is paid SGD 3.20, being 80% of that fee under POL-NS-07, with SGD 0.80 retained as the platform service fee. Under POL-GEN-03, on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling the field amount_sgd carries the same figure as driver_compensation_sgd (SGD 3.20): it is the amount this ruling moves, not a second payment and not a refund to the filing party. The monetary effect (SGD 3.20) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold in POL-GEN-05 and will be executed automatically.

WHY THE CHARGE STANDS — POL-NS-01, all four limbs. (a) EV-TRIP-02704 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 21:58:18 and the wait timer starting at 21:58:20. (b) EV-GPS-02704 (100.0% coverage, no gaps) puts the driver's minimum recorded distance from the pickup pin at 0.11 m, far inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, from the arrival second onward; the 25 m accuracy filter leaves 46 qualifying in-radius fixes. (c) The driver held position inside the geofence for one continuous run of 454 seconds (first fix 21:58:18, last fix 22:05:52, run_count 1), measured on the GPS clock from the first qualifying in-geofence fix (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), against the 300-second free waiting period carried in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec — a surplus of 154 seconds, not a shortfall. platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is null, so no longer threshold applies to limb (d). (d) EV-TRIP-02704 shows no boarding event and no started_at, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 22:05:55 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW — one of the three codes limb (d) recognises — 153 seconds after the required dwell elapsed at 22:03:18.

THE RIDER'S LIMB (d) ARGUMENT IS REJECTED. The rider argues that the driver's own message shows he had not located the rider, so limb (d) fails and the clause's in-radius outcome (full refund, no compensation, a driver-education referral) applies. Limb (d)'s test is the reason code recorded on the trip record, and that code is RIDER_NO_SHOW, which limb (d) expressly recognises. The single chat message (EV-CHAT-02704, 21:58:48, 'I am at the bay, which door are you at', read 21:59:38) is a coordination attempt made while the driver was in fact inside the arrival radius and waiting; it is not a DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE admission, and the record explains it — the rider was never at the pickup. The full-refund branch of POL-NS-01 for in-radius fixes is tied to a mis-selected DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE outcome, which this is not, so it does not fire and no driver-education referral arises.

THE RIDER'S OTHER ROUTES DO NOT HELP HIM. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate him: limb (a) requires at least one message sent by the rider in the waiting window and the log holds only the driver's message, and limb (c) is affirmatively failed, not undecidable — the rider track is present and all 72 rider fixes report 0.0 km/h at 606.0 m to 613.4 m from the pin, outside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius (rider_qualifying_fix_count 0). His account that he was walking to the bay is contradicted by his own device, and the driver's later silence and the empty trip_record.in_app_calls change nothing, because POL-NS-04 needs a rider message before limb (b) can be reached. POL-NS-06 does not bite — the effective dwell of 454 s exceeds the 300 s minimum, so no refund arises; the rider's point that EV-ADVIS-02704-01 is MISSING (weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, disclosed in the claim) and that no advisory permits the waiting clock to be extended or assembled from separate intervals is accepted but immaterial, since the clock already clears the minimum on one continuous run and no fact is asserted from the absent artifact. POL-NS-05 does not apply: at the arrival timestamp the driver was 0.11 m from the pin and stationary, so the marker is true, the clock runs from the tap, and no false-arrival referral is recorded. ruling.explanation:
The SGD 4.00 cancellation fee stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.20, which is 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 fee under POL-NS-07. Both figures are read from the fare breakdown EV-FARE-02704: cancellation_fee 4.00, total_charged 4.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00, and its derived driver_compensation figure of 3.20. On a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling the amount_sgd field carries that same SGD 3.20, as POL-GEN-03 requires.

All four conditions of POL-NS-01 hold on the driver's own telemetry. (a) The trip record EV-TRIP-02704 carries the driver's arrival event at 21:58:18. (b) The GPS trace EV-GPS-02704 places the driver 0.11 m from the pickup pin at that same second, far inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius. (c) He then held position continuously for 454 seconds, from 21:58:18 to 22:05:52, against the 300 second free waiting period carried in trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec - a surplus of 154 seconds, not a shortfall. (d) The record shows no boarding event and a termination by the driver at 22:05:55 under the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, which is one of the three codes the limb recognises, after the required dwell had elapsed. POL-NS-05 does not fire: at the arrival timestamp the driver was at the pin and stationary (dwell-start offset 0.0 s), so the marker is not false and no waiting clock needs recomputing. POL-NS-06 gives the rider nothing: there is no shortfall, and limb (i) is in any event unavailable - the advisory EV-ADVIS-02704-01 is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, so it can carry no fact and nothing in this ruling rests on it; the dwell is a single continuous run of 454 seconds, so no accumulation across intervals is needed. POL-NS-03 is not engaged: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and the trip has one registered pickup point. POL-NS-10 gives nothing: the rider did not cancel, the trip was not scheduled, and the waiting-time line is SGD 0.00.

The rider's arguments are answered. POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider: limb (a) requires a message sent by the rider during the waiting window, and the chat log EV-CHAT-02704 holds a single message sent by the driver at 21:58:48 and read at 21:59:38, with no rider reply. The rider's account that the driver cancelled 'while I was walking to the bay' is contradicted by the rider's own device: all 72 rider fixes report 0.0 km/h and sit between 606 m and 613 m from the pickup pin, with zero qualifying fixes inside the 100 m rider-presence radius. The submission that POL-NS-01 limb (d) fails because the driver 'had not located' the rider is rejected. Limb (d) reads the reason code recorded on the trip record, and that code is RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three the limb recognises. DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE, the code that would not satisfy the limb, is not on this record. The driver's one message asking which door the rider was at is a coordination attempt made during a full 454 second wait, not a recorded admission, and it went unanswered. The driver-education referral the rider asks for attaches only to a cancellation recorded under a code other than the rider's failure to appear; no such code was used here.

On the driver's side, the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and 2 divided by 111 completed trips in 30 days is 0.018, below 0.08. Those are the only two profile fields POL-NS-07 permits for that check. No POL-NS-09 trigger is present: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, no admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence, the counterparty-dispute counters are 0 on both profiles, and the anti-farming check is clear. No escalation, and no clause produces a referral, so the referrals list is empty.

Confidence is 0.94. The deciding facts - the driver's position at the pin, his 454 second dwell, and the manner of termination - are carried by the GPS trace EV-GPS-02704 and the trip record EV-TRIP-02704, both at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. The only artifact below full weight in the bundle is the MISSING advisory, which carries no deciding fact and does not lower the cap. The monetary effect, SGD 3.20, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically, subject to the appeal route.

Both accounts were tested against the record; the driver's account is the one the evidence supports. Times are 29 Aug 2026. Trip matched 21:53:24; driver tapped 'I'm Here' 21:58:18 at the registered pickup point (Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres, zone class STANDARD); the 300-second free waiting period (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) started 21:58:20; the driver cancelled 22:05:55 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. ARRIVAL AND DWELL (POL-NS-01(a)-(c), POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05) - accepted, and both sides agree. EV-GPS-02704 (weight 1.0) puts the driver 0.11 m from the pickup pin at the arrival second and holds him inside the 50 m STANDARD radius continuously from 21:58:18 to 22:05:52: one unbroken run of 454 seconds on 46 qualifying fixes, against the 300 seconds required - a surplus of 154 seconds, so POL-NS-06 (waiting-period shortfall) does not bite and produces no refund. The arrival marker was not false, so POL-NS-05 does not recompute the clock and its false-arrival referral does not fire. REASON CODE, THE RIDER'S MAIN ARGUMENT (POL-NS-01(d)) - rejected. Limb (d) reads the code the trip was terminated under and it is RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three the clause recognises, with no boarding event and the termination at 22:05:55, after the required dwell elapsed at 22:03:18. The clause's full-refund consequence applies only where the record itself terminates under DRIVER_UNABLE_TO_LOCATE with the driver's stationary fixes inside the arrival radius; that is not this record, so the SGD 4.00 fee is not refunded and no driver-education referral arises. The driver's single message ('I am at the bay, which door are you at', EV-CHAT-02704) was sent from the bay 30 seconds after he arrived: it is a coordination attempt, not an admission he could not find the pickup point, and it does not convert the recorded reason code. RIDER ACCOUNT AND RIDER POSITION (POL-NS-04, POL-NS-11) - rejected. The rider track inside EV-GPS-02704 places the rider's device 606-613 m from the pin, stationary (0.0 km/h) across the whole window, so 'walking to the bay' is not supported; the rider was far outside the 100 m rider-presence radius and never replied. POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate: limb (a) fails because the rider sent no message at all, and limb (c) fails on the rider's own positions (were it treated as unrunnable, POL-NS-11 makes it neutral and the fee is still decided on the driver's evidence). WRONG-ENTRANCE (POL-NS-03) - not applicable: the driver's stationary fixes are inside the arrival radius, not outside it, and registered_pickup_points is 1, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill of SGD 2.00 is payable. RIDER'S OWN CANCELLATION ROUTES (POL-NS-10) - nothing to refund: the driver terminated the trip, it was not scheduled, and the waiting-time line is SGD 0.00. MISSING ADVISORY - named as POL-GEN-02 requires: EV-ADVIS-02704-01 is MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; its absence makes POL-NS-06(i) accumulation unavailable, but the dwell clears the minimum without it, so no finding rests on that artifact and its zero weight does not cap confidence. MONEY (EV-FARE-02704): cancellation_fee SGD 4.00, total_charged SGD 4.00, payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd SGD 0.00 - the fee reconciles with platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.00, so there is no POL-NS-08(d) defect. All four POL-NS-01 conditions hold and nothing in POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces them, so the SGD 4.00 charge stands and is not refunded to the rider. POL-NS-07 then pays the driver 80 percent of it: SGD 3.20; the anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations in 30 days, below 4, and 2 of 111 completed trips = 0.018, below 0.08). Because that compensation is paid, the ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd carrying the same SGD 3.20 figure (POL-GEN-03): the SGD 3.20 moves to the driver and is not a refund to the rider. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger is present and no clause produces a referral. To the rider: your SGD 4.00 cancellation fee stands. To the driver: SGD 3.20 is payable to you, with 20 percent retained as the platform service fee. The monetary effect (SGD 3.20) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically; the ruling is provisional and either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
